title: Socratix AI Wins the 2026 Money20/20 Money Awards
summary: Socratix AI won the 2026 Money Awards in the Startup Early Stage category at Money20/20 USA in Las Vegas.
body_markdown:
Socratix won the 2026 Money Awards in the Startup Early Stage category at Money20/20 USA in Las Vegas, and we couldn't be more thrilled!


## The announcement


The winners of the 2026[Money Awards](https://www.money2020.com/awards/finalists-2026-press-release) were revealed live at Money20/20 USA on October 18, 2026. Socratix AI took the **Startup Early Stage** award, chosen from three finalists alongside Aviel Intelligence and Charm Security.


Winner

announced live in Las Vegas


## Why we started Socratix


Community banks and credit unions put enormous time and money into fighting fraud. We started Socratix with a simple goal: free up this time so their teams can focus on what truly matters, serving their customers and members.


That's why Socratix AI builds coworkers that take on investigation work from beginning to end:


- Gather evidence from the systems teams already use
- Evaluate each case against institutional policy and context
- Document a clear, auditable rationale for every recommendation
- Keep analysts in control of consequential decisions


## About the Money Awards


The Money Awards are Money20/20's global fintech awards program, recognizing the companies, products, and partnerships shaping the future of financial services. Entries are evaluated by an independent panel of industry experts.


This year's awards spanned six categories: Startup Early Stage, Startup Growth Stage, Banking, Payments, Partnerships & Strategic Alliance, and Diamond.


## Thank you


Thank you to Money20/20 and the judging panel, and congratulations to our fellow finalists and every winner across this year's categories.


Most of all, this award belongs to the banks, credit unions, and fintechs who trusted us early and helped shape the product, including[First Community Bank and Trust](https://getsocratix.ai/blog/case-study/first-community-bank-trust) ,[Super.com](https://getsocratix.ai/blog/case-study/supercom) , and[AtoB](https://getsocratix.ai/blog/case-study/atob) .
